title: A/P Summary: clicking a vendor opens A/P Unpaid Invoices with the same filters
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, with {Location-A} as your current location.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • The organization has open documents in these reports at two locations, {Location-A} and {Location-B}, and you are enrolled at both; {Location-A}'s name comes first in A to Z order.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919 and {Location-B} is Staging Lethbridge - 4310.
  • Vendor {Vendor-A} has bills at {Location-A} more than 90 days past due on yesterday's date.
    For example: {Vendor-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S5-27 Drill Down.
  • Starting screen: A/P Summary (Reports, then "A/P Aging Summary" under ACCOUNTS PAYABLE in the left menu) is open in a desktop browser window 1440 px wide, as opened from the Reports menu.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Change the as-of date to yesterday.
  2. In the Past due filter, tick "91+ days".
  3. In the Location filter, untick {Location-B}.
  4. Click {Vendor-A}'s name.
  5. Read the page title and every chip.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the report shows yesterday.
  • Step 2: the chip reads "Past due: 91+ days".
  • Step 3: the report narrows to {Location-A}.
  • Step 4: A/P Unpaid Invoices opens.
  • Step 5: only {Vendor-A} is ticked on the Vendor chip, the as-of date is yesterday, "Past due: 91+ days", and only {Location-A} is ticked.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "A/R and A/P Report Sorting, Export and Location Filter", Confluence 947650561, version 5 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11315, story SV-11535 (Story 5, Filters: customer or vendor, past due and location)

  • S5-R11: “Clicking a customer or vendor on A/R Summary or A/P Summary opens A/R Collection or A/P Unpaid Invoices with just that customer or vendor ticked, the same as-of date, the same ticked Past due ranges and the same ticked locations.”
  • Key Decisions, drill-down: “Drill-down keeps the report's scope. Clicking a customer or vendor on a Summary opens Collection or Unpaid Invoices with the same as-of date and the same chosen locations. Basis: d-drill-in-inherits-scope.”
  • What changes for existing users: “Clicking a row no longer opens it. The document number, or the customer or vendor name on the Summaries, is the link, as on the newer reports (Story 7).”
